<span class="atom-split" id="q01" data-atom="q01" data-title="Russia 2020 — Quesito 1" data-tags="kg/prova,paese/Azerbaijan,comp/Azerbaijan,cluster/Elettromagnetismo,object/rod"></span>

<div class="qlang-switch" data-default="en"></div>



Problem 1. There are two conductive rods with length land resistance R are initially at rest on two
parallel friction-less rails. Initially there’s a distance d between the rods. There also exists a magnetic
field B perpendicular to the plane of the rods and the rails. Masses of the both the rods are equal to m.
Initially, a speed v was given to the right rod. Find the distance between the rods after a long time.

<div class="qlang-split" data-lang="it"></div>

Problema 1. Ci sono due bastone conduttive con lunghezza resistenza al suolo R sono inizialmente a riposo su due
trame parallele senza attrito. Inizialmente c'è una distanza d tra le barre. C'è anche un magnetico
campo B perpendicolare al piano delle barre e dei binari. Le masse di entrambe le barre sono uguali a m.
Inizialmente, una velocità v fu data alla barra destra. Trova la distanza tra le barre dopo un lungo periodo.

twice less. Find the minimal time for going from point S to F. Picture is symmetric. Give your answer
in terms of $\alpha$, h, L, and v.

- Due volte meno. Trova il tempo minimo per andare dal punto S a F. L'immagine è simmetrica. Rispondi .

<span class="atom-split" id="q03" data-atom="q03" data-title="Russia 2020 — Quesito 3" data-tags="kg/prova,paese/Azerbaijan,comp/Azerbaijan,cluster/Elettromagnetismo,object/mirror"></span>

<div class="qlang-switch" data-default="en"></div>



Problem 3. A light beam with frequency $\omega0$ falls to a mirror that possesses mass m and a velocity
of v. Find the frequency of the light beam that reflected from mirror. Light beam falls normal to the
mirror. The mirror’s velocity is the same direction with speed of the light (in other words, the velocity
vectors are parallel).

**Topic:** [[Special Relativity]], [[Oscillations & Waves]]

<div class="qlang-switch" data-default="en"></div>



Problem 4. There’s a one mole ideal gas doing some process. The process consists of an isotherm (1, 2),
an isochore (2, 3), a polytropic process (3, 4), and an isobar (4, 1). The molar capacity of gas during
polytropic process is C = 0.5R. Minimal temperature of the gas during the whole cycle is Tmin = 300 K.
Find the efficiency of this cycle.

![[_attachments/AzPhO-2020/AzPhO-2020_p2_f3.png]]

<!--fig:end-->
